quest.title: Meteoric Lance
quest.description: Trace and find the Narzissenkreuz Ordo's seals.

chapter.num: In the Wake of Narcissus: Act I
chapter.title: Search in the Algae Sea

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: ...Shouldn't you be more concerned with the person lying on the ground in your field of vision?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Wah! What happened...?

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: My apologies, Miss. I prioritized the search for the stone tablet. Allow me to conduct a scan now...

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: ...My apologies, Miss.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Though he's still alive, the breath of life has escaped his body through the orifices. I've seen this handiwork before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eek! Paimon can't look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We have to get help! We can't just leave him like this!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Together, you deliver the unconscious man to Lumidouce Harbor.\nThe people there immediately take him to receive medical treatment.\nKnowing that he is in good hands, you all return to where you were before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! Now let's have a look at this stone tablet.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: "Lo, this place is the Orthant of Wishes, the Temple of Wishes, the Room of Wishes..."

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: "Often contradicting"... "Born in an instant, your company in eternal rest, never separated"... "The tainted fruits of sin"...

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Another riddle.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why do something so scary here... Could it have something to do with the answer to the riddle?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Well, Fontainians are "sinners," life tainted with original sin.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: For this reason, the answer is "life." I suppose I'd guessed it already.

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: Can you be sure that's the answer?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: I know the rhetoric and semiotics of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo all too well. Barring any surprises, that is the answer.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Okay, it's time to make up for lost time. We need to hurry now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eek! Th—There's someone on the ground!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Examine the fallen person...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is... Is he...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He's still alive, just unconscious.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew! That's good.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We have to get help! We can't just leave him like this!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You and Paimon deliver the unconscious man to Lumidouce Harbor.\nThe people there immediately take him to receive medical treatment.\nKnowing that he is in good hands, the two of you return to where you were before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! Now let's have a look at this stone tablet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Lo, this place is the Orthant of Wishes, the Temple of Wishes, the Room of Wishes..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Often contradicting"... "Born in an instant, your company in eternal rest, never separated"... "The tainted fruits of sin"...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like a riddle!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm... What do you think the answer is then, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Life?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds strange. Can life really bear original sin?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, Paimon thinks she might have heard that somewhere before. Let's go with that answer for now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Guilt?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon doesn't think that's it. Paimon only feels guilty about something for 15 minutes, tops.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm... What do you think the answer is then, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You carefully inspect the top of the mechanism, but you don't find anything.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's nothing here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no! It looks like someone already took whatever was here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But who?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You carefully inspect the top of the mechanism, but you don't find anything.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's nothing here?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: It looks like something was here, but someone else took it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, doesn't that mean that our plan's already failed?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: The birth of "Reason" requires the merging of the four Orthants. If we can get the rest of them, we still have a chance.

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: In that case, we'd better hurry to the next area.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A dream?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon doesn't think so... Just what kind of weird thing would you have to dream up for it to be a sin?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm... What do you think the answer is then, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You carefully inspect the top of the mechanism, but you don't find anything.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's nothing here either...

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: What exactly are we looking for, Caterpillar?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: We're looking for the materials necessary to forge the Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: The Ordo was able to reproduce the four requisite hypothetical substances here in the material world, based on the esoteric philosophies of the underground kingdom and ancient Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: I do not understand.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: These enigmatic substances are purely experiential. You could say they are even further beyond ordinary logic than elemental power.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: I entered all introductory to intermediate level textbooks from the Akademiya's Spantamad into my memory banks decades ago. There is nothing mysterious about elemental power.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Is that so? Anyway, to sum up, this is born of the confluence of traditions from Fontaine and technology from the ancient underground kingdom.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: And thus, four types of substance came into being: Memory, Wish, Soul, and Persona.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: To avoid any possible ambiguity, let's call them the "Memory" piece, "Wish" piece, "Soul" piece, and "Persona" piece.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why are these used to make the Holy Blade?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: In the Narzissenkreuz Ordo's brand of mystical philosophy, the temple is a microcosm of the universe, the members are stand-ins for the gods, and the holy oil is tempered willpower.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: The Holy Blade, on the other hand, is "reason," that which cuts everything open. It can only be born out of consummate human will.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Quite abstruse.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: That's esotericism for you. You attach yourself to anything that looks similar enough, and when this sort of thing becomes magic, fiction becomes reality.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Anyway, we should make our way to the next area now.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You carefully inspect the top of the mechanism, but you don't find anything.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did someone... take whatever was here, too?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Looks that way.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just who is...?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: It's Jakob.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: We had an altercation with him inside Elynas once... Clarification: Recently, not "once."

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: When I saw that unfortunate victim at the gate, I knew it was his handiwork. It seems he's still active after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then what does he want with the stuff he took from here?

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Simple — He too wants to reforge the Holy Blade of Narzissenkreuz. The dream of the Ordo remains unrealized.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: Anyway, we should make our way to the final area now.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You carefully inspect the top of the mechanism, but you don't find anything.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's nothing here either...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You carefully inspect the top of the mechanism, but you don't find anything.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did someone... take whatever was here, too?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This door's already open? Wait a minute, Paimon thought it was sealed.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Is this the place? I've confirmed the presence of another stone tablet in my field of vision.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: This is the third seal.

dialogues.speaker: Caterpillar
dialogues.text: We should be getting close. Be careful.
